follow-up time: up to six months after birth
exposure: gestational age at preeclampsia onset (≤32, ≤34, or ≤36 weeks)
cohort: 1511 pregnant women attending routine checkups at the Outpatient Department of the University Hospital in Plovdiv, Bulgaria.
finding: Independent predictors of preeclampsia in all pregnant women were mean arterial blood pressure, intrauterine growth retardation, pregnancy-associated protein-A, and cervical length.
